ownership.summary: Tineco is a consumer brand within Shanghai-listed Ecovacs Robotics Co., Ltd. The group's 2025 annual report identifies Tineco Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. as a wholly owned subsidiary and describes ECOVACS and Tineco as a dual-brand structure. ECOVACS Robotics and Tineco are distinct consumer brands with different portfolios, even though they share listed-group control.

leadership.name: Qian Dongqi
leadership.context: Tineco's official Chinese company profile identifies Qian Dongqi as founder of the Tineco brand.

leadership.name: Ling Leng
leadership.context: Tineco's June 2025 release identifies Ling Leng as CEO; an Ecovacs filing says he has served as general manager of the Tineco brand since October 2020.

productPortfolio.name: FLOOR ONE floor washers
productPortfolio.positioning: The flagship wet-and-dry hard-floor category, emphasizing sensors, edge cleaning, low-profile access and dock-based self-cleaning.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Forms the flagship Tineco assortment across sensor, access and self-cleaning feature tiers.

productPortfolio.name: Cordless stick vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: Dry floorcare systems sold under the PURE ONE and A-series families.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Adds dry floorcare through distinct PURE ONE and A-series product families.

productPortfolio.name: Carpet cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: Upright and portable deep-cleaning appliances that broaden the floorcare portfolio.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Broadens assortment planning into upright and portable deep-cleaning use cases.

productPortfolio.name: Kitchen and beauty appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Cooking, hair-care and personal-care products positioned as smart lifestyle appliances rather than ECOVACS service robots.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Requires separate lifestyle-appliance assortment planning from ECOVACS-branded service robots.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Ecovacs Robotics Co., Ltd.'s 2025 annual report treats Tineco Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. as a separate wholly owned subsidiary responsible for the Tineco side of the group's dual-brand strategy.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm that the contract names the Tineco entity responsible for the product.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The annual report says the group mainly uses self-production and describes a planned Tineco project with designed annual capacity of 12 million high-end smart lifestyle appliances.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Group disclosure and planned Tineco project
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm whether the contracted model is produced within the planned Tineco capacity or elsewhere.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: A January 2025 EU declaration for the A20 and A30 cordless-vacuum series names Tineco Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. in Suzhou as manufacturer and Dechang Vietnam Co., Ltd. in Dong Nai as factory. That document is model-series evidence, not a factory map for all Tineco products.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the EU declaration to the exact A20 or A30 SKU before relying on the named Vietnam factory.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Tineco's company history says its 1998 factory has grown beyond 80,000 square metres, but current model origin still needs product-level verification.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify current model origin on the product label and compliance documents.

marketsChannels.evidence: Tineco's company history dates a North American branch in Seattle to 2019, a Japan office to 2020 and a European branch in Düsseldorf to 2021.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the regional entity responsible for sales, service and warranty.

marketsChannels.evidence: Its June 2025 U.S. release names Amazon, Tineco's online store and more than 10,000 retail locations, including Target, Walmart, Best Buy, Costco, Home Depot and Canadian Tire.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm seller authorization and warranty coverage for the target retail or ecommerce account.

marketsChannels.evidence: Official country sites and distributor contacts support sales across North America, Europe and Asia, while exact availability and warranty terms remain market-specific.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify local availability, distributor authorization and warranty terms.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Tineco's strongest position is in sensor-led wet-and-dry floor washers, supported by broad U.S. retail distribution and the manufacturing scale of the Ecovacs group. Its main strategic risk is category concentration: rivals are rapidly matching self-cleaning, hot-wash, drying and lay-flat features, while expansion into kitchen and beauty appliances must build credibility without blurring the separate ECOVACS robotics brand.
